title: Retry: move Transport row from gh/mod.rs to gh/transport.rs
summary: Retry of structure-pass job G2: move the Transport items verbatim into gh/transport.rs, re-export them from gh/mod.rs so public paths stay unchanged, and add a CHANGELOG entry. The audience is the verifier applying section 5 of structure-pass.md. The caller-check evidence is placed where the verifier can see it, since the earlier rejection came from the report not reaching it.

defaults_applied.how: cargo test, clippy and fmt criteria.
Behavior criteria name the commands the verifier runs.
Test-list equality and passing retry tests, plus diff-moved check, rather than file existence.
Caller-check evidence is put in the change itself so it no longer depends on the report reaching the verifier.
CHANGELOG entry written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The request as typed is to retry the G2 move; the introspection's proposed handover-check work is a separate change and is out of scope here.
The earlier candidate was essentially correct (verifier found no content defects); only the unconfirmable report criterion failed.
Moved items: Runner, GhCli, GhFailure, parse_status, is_transient, transient_text, Retry, retry_transient, clock_entropy, HttpReply, HttpPost, CurlHttp, HostErrorLog.
A private `use` for clock_entropy in mod.rs is acceptable if tests and GhClient compile; extra `use` lines in test modules are allowed import edits under section 5 rule 1.
The caller check is recorded in the CHANGELOG entry (one line naming the Grep and the unchanged count of outside-gh callers) as well as in the report, so it is checkable from the change itself.
The dependency job 20261026-232356-ds51 has landed in the base.

acceptance_criteria.text: gh/transport.rs holds the 13 Transport row items with text identical to before; `git diff -M --color-moved` shows only moved lines plus the mod/re-export lines.

gh/mod.rs declares `mod transport;` and re-exports every moved item that had a public or crate-visible path, so no file outside gh/ changes. Test modules differ only in `use` lines and the test list is unchanged.

The CHANGELOG.md entry for the move states the caller check: a Grep of crates/ for each moved name's old `gh::<name>` path, with the hit count outside gh/ and that no caller file changed. The producer's final report repeats the Grep per moved name with counts.
Only gh/mod.rs, gh/transport.rs and CHANGELOG.md change; no config, workflow or other docs file changes.
Run `cargo test --locked -- --list` and compare test names with the base; they match. Run `cargo test --locked`; it passes, including the retry tests using the moved code.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`; both are clean.

out_of_scope: Adding a producer-to-verifier handover check in Athena itself
Behavior changes or refactors of the moved code
departures: Pass probability raised from reference: the prior candidate had no content defects and this reading puts the caller check into the CHANGELOG, which the verifier can see.
